_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: NEW: the public CPL Fact Sheet is LIVE — share cpl-initiative.github.io/cpl-project-tracker/fact-sheet/ with consultants (it sits alone — no access to the other COBI tabs), or open it from the 📄 CPL Fact Sheet link in the left nav rail. The headline KPIs auto-update; hit '🖨 Print / Save PDF' for the always-current PDF. When you have a moment, eyeball the SEMI-STATIC figures (the Vision 2030 workplan SCRs 332/889/37.35%/274 and the 5-year funding table) and tell me any that have moved — those are baked, not live.

From Session 73 (live now): the CPL Assistant has three improvements — try a few questions and tell me what to tune. (1) Ask about a STATEWIDE credit (e.g. a statewide RE or firefighter recommendation): it should say it's available system-wide and point you to YOUR college's landing page, not one specific college. (2) Ask 'what credit can I get for an EMT license?': it should LIST the eligible course titles + units, not just a number. (3) Ask a broad 'which colleges give credit for X': it should ASK whether you want a specific region or all options before showing a long list.

Also fixed Session 73: the assistant's college CPL landing-page links were broken/stale (San Diego Miramar pointed at the wrong code). They're now synced from the MAP College Landing Page API and auto-refresh weekly, so they should match map.rccd.edu/cpllandingpages. Click a couple from a college-specific answer and flag any that still misfire.

Carry-over: the merge worklist groups WORD VARIANTS — 'Conversational Japanese' ↔ 'Japanese Conversation', 'Assisting' ↔ 'Assistant' (~866 more group). Confirm the clean language-conversation families when you get a chance. Where a group shows an amber '⚠ Spans N disciplines' note, eyeball it for homonyms (music vs office 'keyboard') before confirming.
Standing bonus: we'll keep adding Arroyo-Seco-style California plein-air landscapes (Redmond, Guy Rose, Wendt, Payne) to First Light — flag any artist/work you'd love and we'll source it.

Fact-Sheet follow-ups: (1) IN PROGRESS — live-wire the SNAPSHOT tier so the 5 exhibit/recommendation KPI cards + the Statewide Exhibits per-sector counts auto-update (a committed daily CustomReport snapshot the page fetches). (2) Reproduce the 'One Knowledge Layer' technology-landscape diagram as live HTML/SVG (sharper + regen-proof). Read docs/fact_sheet_lessons.md + docs/kb-notes/playbook-standalone-public-page.md first.

When the merge wave settles (NOT per-merge): the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint — close gaps + re-sort 001,002… by title within each (canonical SUBJ4, band). Full Rule-7, unverified-only, ONE pass. Scope: docs/unverified_mid_renumber_scope.md. Dry-run first, Sam's go before apply + Supabase re-key.

TMC Phase-2 ACCEPTANCE ENGINE in tmc_builder.js (Sam: 'Go for A'): per-slot verdict from the ASCCC rules (C-ID match = ✓ · slot.flexible = ⚠ accept-with-ASSIST · specific C-ID filled by a non-match = faculty review · unfilled = ○) + structural checklist + a Ready/N-issues banner. Consume slot.flexible + t.flexibility (#479). Scope: docs/kb-notes/tmc-co-review-scope.md.

CPL-Assistant CCR/CER-grounded recommender ETL (green-lit, the big next build): build the CCR/CER/adoption-leverage ETL into shared Supabase so the Assistant can recommend the likely local course + credit rec, grounded in real course-identity data. Scope: docs/kb-notes/cpl-assistant-ccr-cer-recommendation-scope.md. The v17 multi-turn plumbing is the foundation. Sierra rename lands with the Student Portal, not piecemeal.
